findings.issue: The barkeep is female: her own line 'I'm no tavern wench' is rendered لستُ نادلة حانة (feminine), and character_cards.yaml puts Hilga in the tavern-keeper role. Her stage directions are all masculine, so the same speaker is male in the parentheticals and female in the dialogue. This is a cross-cutting call - if the owner rules the Barkeep is a separate male NPC, all four rows stay as they are, but they cannot stay inconsistent with نادلة.
